description: This file defines a React component 'IngestionClient' for a Next.js frontend application. It facilitates uploading documents across three categories, managing upload states, and orchestrating a workflow to generate a persona draft by interacting with backend API endpoints. It includes subcomponents for file upload cards and LinkedIn connection, and manages UI state, progress, and error handling.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a byte count into a human-readable string with units (B, KB, MB, GB).

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Returns the file extension label in uppercase; defaults to 'FILE' if no extension.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a short random string ID.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns the display label for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Returns the title text for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns the color code associated with each upload category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns the accept attribute string for file input, supporting PDF, DOCX, and TXT.
